info.title: Accounts Payable
info.description: Accounts Payable (AP) enables you to keep track of your vendor accounts and bills. Basically, you enter and edit your vendor transactions, and then pay them.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Account labels
tags.description:
Account labels provide descriptive names for General Ledger (GL) accounts used in Accounts Payable (AP) transactions and reporting. Note that account labels must be enabled in the AP application settings before they can be used.

**When to use:** Use to help identify correct GL accounts through intuitive naming. Account labels can also help control access, since users can code transactions using only those GL accounts that are assigned a label.

**Relationships:** Associated with a GL account and optional offset GL account.
Can include 1099 settings used when posting transactions with the label.

**Lifecycle context:** Created and maintained as reference data before transaction entry.
Selected on AP transactions to control account posting behavior and reporting classification.

For more information, see [About AP account labels](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_AP_account_labels) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Adjustments
tags.description:
Accounts payable adjustments represent vendor debit or credit memo transactions that increase or decrease the amount owed to a vendor. They help keep vendor balances accurate when corrections, credits, write-offs, or other adjustments are needed outside the standard bill process.

**When to use**: Use this object when an integration needs to create, retrieve, or manage adjustments to vendor balances without changing the original bill. It is useful for workflows that apply credits, record debit memos, correct payable amounts, or synchronize adjustment activity from another system.

**Relationships**: Each adjustment is associated with a vendor and can include adjustment lines that capture the individual transaction details. For VAT-enabled transactions, adjustment tax entries provide tax information for the related adjustment line.

**Lifecycle context**: This object participates in the payable adjustment workflow from draft or submission through posting and payment application. Its state reflects where the adjustment is in processing, such as draft, posted, partially paid, paid, reversed, or selected for payment.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Adjustment lines
tags.description:
Adjustment lines represent the individual line items within an AP adjustment, capturing the specific amounts, accounts, and details that make up the overall adjustment. They provide the transactional breakdown needed for accurate accounting, reporting, and tax handling.

**When to use**: Use this object when creating or retrieving the detailed components of an adjustment, such as distributing amounts across accounts, dimensions, or projects. It is essential when integrations need line-level accuracy for financial processing or reconciliation.

**Relationships**: Adjustment lines belong to a parent accounts payable adjustment and inherit key context such as the associated vendor and transaction header. They can also be linked to tax entries in VAT-enabled environments, which provide tax details tied to each line.

**Lifecycle context**: This object is used during the processing and posting stages of the adjustment workflow, where line-level details are defined, validated, and ultimately posted to the general ledger. It supports downstream reporting by preserving the granular breakdown of each adjustment.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Adjustment tax entries
tags.description:
For VAT enabled transactions, adjustment tax entries represent the tax details associated with an accounts payable adjustment. Tax entries capture how tax amounts are calculated, applied, and reported for the transaction. Tax entries ensure that adjustments reflect accurate tax treatment for compliance and financial reporting.

**When to use**: Use this object when creating or retrieving AP adjustments that include tax impacts, especially in regions or scenarios where tax must be explicitly calculated or itemized. It is also relevant when validating or auditing the tax breakdown applied to an adjustment. Create and maintain adjustment tax entries from the owning [AP adjustment line](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/accounts-payable/groups/adjustments/tags/accounts_payable_adjustment-lines) object.

**Relationships**: Tax entries belong to an owning accounts payable adjustment line and define the full financial and tax composition of the transaction. They rely on tax configuration objects such as tax solutions, tax codes, and jurisdictions to determine the correct tax treatment.

**Lifecycle context**: Tax entries are established during adjustment creation and calculation, and they are finalized when the adjustment is posted. They continue to play a role in downstream reporting, compliance, and audit processes.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Adjustment summaries
tags.description:
Summaries are collections of the same type of transactions, grouped together and posted to the General Ledger using the date determined by the summary frequency. Individual transactions in a summary are processed immediately.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving or reviewing grouped AP adjustments that should be
processed together. To create a summary for adjustments, use the [Accounts Payable summary](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/accounts-payable/tags/accounts_payable_summaries) endpoint.

**Relationships:** Can reference a parent summary and related bank account information,
and contains aggregate values such as total amount and posting details.

**Lifecycle context:** Created as grouped transaction batches that remain open while
adjustments are added, and are closed after processing is complete.

For more information, see [Accounts Payable summary overview](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=AP_summary_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Advances
tags.description:
An AP advance represents a prepayment made to a vendor before a bill is received, such
as a deposit or retainer fee.

**When to use:** Use when recording vendor prepayments, applying advance payments to
outstanding vendor bills, or retrieving advance payment activity for reconciliation.

**Relationships:** Contains advance lines that distribute the payment across GL accounts.
Associated with a vendor and linked to an AP summary. Optionally linked to a bank account
for reconciliation.

**Lifecycle context:** Created as a draft and submitted for payment processing. Once paid,
applied to future vendor bills to reduce outstanding AP balances. The advance state
transitions through workflow operations such as Submit and Reverse.

For more information, see [About AP advances](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Advances_with_Depts___Locs) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Advance lines
tags.description:
An advance line represents an individual line item within an AP advance, recording a
portion of the advance payment and its GL account distribution.

**When to use:** Use when creating advance lines to distribute an AP advance across GL
accounts, updating line amounts or dimensions, retrieving individual line details for
analysis or reconciliation, or deleting lines from an advance that is in a draft state.

**Relationships:** Owned by the AP advance object and linked to a GL account. Optionally
associated with an account label and dimension values such as department and location.

**Lifecycle context:** Created when an AP advance is submitted and retained as part of
the advance record for reporting and reconciliation.

For more information, see [About AP advances](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Advances_with_Depts___Locs) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Bills
tags.description:
Bills represent Accounts Payable transactions that record amounts owed to a vendor for goods or services. This object is the primary record used to track, manage, and settle amounts owed to vendors within the AP workflow.

**When to use**: Use this object when creating or managing vendor invoices in Sage Intacct, including importing bills from external systems or maintaining payable balances. It is commonly used in integrations that automate invoice ingestion or synchronize purchasing activity into Accounts Payable.

**Relationships**: Bills are associated with vendor records and include one or more bill lines that capture detailed charges, distributions, and tax information. They are also linked to downstream payment and adjustment objects that act on the payable after it is created.

**Lifecycle context**: Participates in the core processing stage of the procure-to-pay lifecycle, starting when a vendor charge is recorded and continuing through approval, payment, and posting. It acts as the central transaction that bridges purchasing activity and payment execution in Accounts Payable.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Bill lines
tags.description:
Bill lines are line items that represent charges for purchased items or services on a bill.
Use bill lines to record individual amounts, dimensions, and other details that roll up to the bill.

Bill lines represent the individual line items within a bill, capturing the detailed charges for goods or services, including amounts, accounts, and dimensional allocations. These records define how the total payable is distributed for accounting and reporting purposes.

**When to use**: Use this object when creating or updating detailed charges on a bill, such as specifying GL accounts, amounts, or dimensions for each expense line. It is commonly used in integrations that need to map itemized invoice data into accurate financial distributions.

**Relationships**: Bill lines are child records of a bill and inherit context such as vendor and transaction details from the parent. They are associated with GL accounts, dimensions, and tax entries, which provide the accounting and compliance details required for each charge.

**Lifecycle context**: Participates in the transaction processing stage by defining the detailed composition of a payable before approval and posting. These records directly influence how expenses are recognized in the general ledger once the bill is processed.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Bill tax entries
tags.description:
Bill tax entries represent the tax details associated with a bill line on VAT-enabled transactions, including calculated or specified tax amounts, rates, and applicable tax rules. These records ensure that taxes on vendor charges are accurately captured for compliance and financial reporting. Create and maintain bill tax entries from the owning [AP bill line](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/accounts-payable/groups/bills/tags/accounts_payable_bill-lines) object.

**When to use**: Use this object when your integration needs to apply, calculate, or override taxes on bill line items in VAT-enabled environments. It is commonly used when importing invoices that include tax breakdowns or when precise tax control is required.

**Relationships**: Bill tax entries are child records of bill lines and derive context from the parent bill and its associated vendor transaction. They also reference tax configuration objects such as tax details, which define the applicable tax type, rate, and posting behavior.

**Lifecycle context**: Participates in the transaction processing stage by defining tax amounts before the bill is approved and posted. These records directly impact how tax liabilities are calculated, recorded, and ultimately reported in the general ledger and tax filings.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Bill summaries
tags.description:
Summaries are collections of the same type of transactions, grouped together and posted to the General Ledger using the date determined by the summary frequency. Individual transactions in a summary are processed immediately.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving or reviewing grouped AP bill transactions and their posting context. To create a summary for bills, use the [Accounts Payable summary](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/accounts-payable/tags/accounts_payable_summaries) endpoint.

**Relationships:** Can reference a parent summary and related bank account information, and contains aggregate values such as total amount and posting details.

**Lifecycle context:** Created as grouped transaction batches that remain open while bills are added, and are closed after processing is complete.

For more information, see [Accounts Payable summary overview](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=AP_summary_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Amortization templates
tags.description:
An amortization template defines the default configuration for amortizing prepaid or deferred expenses across accounting periods, including how and when amounts are recognized. It ensures consistent and automated expense allocation from source transactions.

**When to use**: Use this object to manage the predefined amortization rules that should be applied when creating prepaid expense schedules from AP transactions or other sources. It is useful when your integration needs to standardize and automate expense recognition over time.

**Relationships**: Works with Accounts Payable transactions, such as bills, that supply the source amounts for amortization. It supports the creation of downstream prepaid expense schedules and entries that drive periodic journal postings.

**Lifecycle context**: Used during setup to define amortization behavior before transactions are processed. Its configuration drives the generation, scheduling, and posting of expense recognition entries over time.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Joint payees
tags.description:
A joint payee identifies an additional recipient, along with the vendor, for a joint check payment on an AP bill.

**When to use:** Construction subscription is needed. Use when a bill payment must be issued jointly to the vendor and another party, such as a subcontractor, so both names appear on the printed check.

**Relationships:** Owned by the AP bill and referenced when a payment that uses the joint check method is issued.

**Lifecycle context:** Added to a bill before payment and locked from further changes once referenced by a joint check payment, keeping the printed check details consistent with the completed payment.

For more information, see [Joint check basics](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Constr_JointCheck-basics) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Payments
tags.description:
An AP payment represents a payment transaction applied to one or more outstanding (AP) balances, such as vendor bills, credit adjustments, or advances. This object captures how payment amounts are allocated across specific AP documents, including support for partial payments, discounts, credits, and multi-document settlements.

**When to use**: Use this object when recording new vendor payments, retrieving payment activity, or reconciling outstanding AP balances as part of an automated or manual payment workflow.

**Relationships**: Linked to AP transactions such as bills, debit and credit adjustments, and advances, with line-level payment allocations.

**Lifecycle context**: Captures the payment stage of the AP lifecycle, reducing outstanding liabilities and completing the vendor payment process.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Payment lines
tags.description:
A payment line represents an individual line item within an AP payment. Each payment line records a portion of a payment, enabling detailed tracking of how payment amounts are structured and applied within a payment object.

**When to use**: Use to retrieve or analyze individual entries that make up a payment.

**Relationships**: Owned by the AP payment object and associated with payment details that link to underlying AP transactions.

**Lifecycle context**: Created during payment processing and retained as part of the final payment record for reporting and reconciliation.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Payment details
tags.description:
AP payment details represent how a payment is applied to specific accounts payable (AP) transactions, including bills, adjustments, and advances, with optional line-level detail.

**When to use**: Use to retrieve or validate how payment amounts are allocated across AP transactions.

**Relationships**: Owned by the AP payment object and linked to underlying AP transactions and their line items.

**Lifecycle context**: Created during payment processing to define allocation of payment amounts and retained for reconciliation and audit purposes.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Recurring bills
tags.description:
A recurring bill defines a schedule for automatically generating AP bills at regular
intervals, commonly used for fixed, repeating expenses such as monthly rent or service fees.

**When to use:** Use to automate AP bill creation for regularly-occurring, fixed-amount
expenses. Supports non-standard recurring transaction schedules and automatically creates
and posts bills based on the defined schedule.

**Relationships:** Linked to a vendor and optionally to a contract. Contains line items
that define the GL account and amount distribution. Associated with payment terms and a
recurring schedule that tracks execution history.

**Lifecycle context:** When a scheduled execution triggers, Sage Intacct automatically
creates and posts an AP bill. The generated bills can be viewed and managed independently
of the recurring bill.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Recurring bill lines
tags.description:
A recurring bill line represents an individual line item within a recurring bill,
defining the GL account, amount, and other transaction details for each charge.

**When to use:** Use to create, update, or retrieve charges on a recurring bill, such as GL account assignments, amounts, or dimension details for a specific line.

**Relationships:** Owned by the recurring bill. Associated with a GL account and
optionally linked to dimensions such as location, department, and project. May also
reference a transaction allocation template or AP account label.

**Lifecycle context:** Created as part of the recurring bill and used as the basis for
generating corresponding lines in each AP bill produced by the recurring bill schedule.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Recurring bill tax entries
tags.description:
A recurring bill tax entry records the individual tax details for a line on an AP recurring
bill. Tax entries are included on recurring bill lines for VAT-enabled transactions.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve tax entry details for lines on a recurring bill. To create
or update tax entries, create or update the recurring bill line that contains them.

**Relationships:** Owned by the recurring bill line. Associated with a purchasing tax detail
that defines the applicable tax type and rate.

**Lifecycle context:** Tax entries are generated as part of the recurring bill line and
provide the tax amounts used when the recurring bill produces AP bills.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Summaries
tags.description:
Summaries are collections of the same type of transactions, grouped together and posted to the General Ledger using the date determined by the summary frequency. Individual transactions in a summary are processed immediately.

**When to use:** Use when creating, retrieving, or reviewing grouped AP transactions that should be processed together.

**Relationships:** Can reference a parent summary and related bank account information, and contains aggregate values such as total amount and posting details.

**Lifecycle context:** Created as grouped transaction batches that remain open while transactions are added, and are closed after processing is complete.

For more information, see [Accounts Payable summary overview](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=AP_summary_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Terms
tags.description:
An AP term defines the credit period a vendor extends to your company, including when payment is due and any discounts or penalties that apply.

**When to use:** Use when creating a new payment term, retrieving or updating existing terms, or configuring due date calculations, early payment discounts, and late payment penalties that can be applied to vendor bills and other AP transactions.

**Relationships:** Associated with vendors and referenced by AP transactions, such as bills, to determine due dates and discount or penalty calculations.

**Lifecycle context:** Terms are configured before bills are created and applied when a bill is entered, driving the bill's due date and any discount or penalty calculations throughout the AP lifecycle.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Check runs
tags.description:
A check run processes up to 1,000 checks at a time in a single offline print job, grouping payment requests together under shared print settings such as check stock and checking account.

**When to use:** Use when creating a batch of checks to print, retrieving check run details or settings, or updating check run configuration such as check stock, checking account, or print options before the checks are printed.

**Relationships:** Referenced by AP payments that are added to the check run for batch printing, and associated with a checking account used to print the checks.

**Lifecycle context:** Created before payment requests are added, and its configuration controls how the included payments are formatted and printed together.

For more information, see [Check run overview](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Check_run_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Vendors
tags.description:
Vendors are individuals or companies that you pay for goods and services.

**When to use:** Use when adding a new supplier or service provider to the system before recording AP bills or purchasing transactions against them, or when retrieving or updating vendor payment settings, contact details, and account configurations.

**Relationships:** Linked to AP bills, payments, and purchasing transactions; bills and purchasing transactions are recorded against the vendor, and payments are applied to settle outstanding balances. A vendor can be associated with contacts (for pay-to, remittance, and 1099 recipient roles), AP terms (for payment due dates and discount rules), a vendor type (for reporting groupings), a parent vendor (to link a subsidiary to its owning entity), GL accounts (for expense and offset posting), price lists and price schedules (for default pricing on purchasing transactions), and payment providers and bank file setup records (for electronic payment delivery).

**Lifecycle context:** Vendors are configured before AP transactions are created. When vendor approval is enabled, a vendor must be in an approved state before AP bills and purchasing transactions can be posted.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Vendor account numbers
tags.description:
A vendor account number is the account number that a vendor assigns to a specific entity location in a multi-entity company. For example, a telephone company might assign an account number to identify which entity is paying a bill.

**When to use:** Use to assign a vendor's account number to a specific entity location so that the number appears on payment documents for that entity, helping match payments with bills from the vendor.

**Relationships:** Owned by a vendor and linked to a specific entity location. Vendor account numbers are managed through the parent vendor's `vendorAccountNumberList` array.

**Lifecycle context:** Vendor account numbers are set up after a vendor is created and before payments are issued for that entity.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Vendor bank file setups
tags.description:
Vendor bank file setup contains the bank account details required to deliver electronic payments to a vendor using a local bank file format.

**When to use:** Use to configure the bank account details for a vendor before generating bank file payment batches that pay that vendor electronically.

**Relationships:** Owned by a vendor. Vendor bank file setup records are referenced by bank file payment batches when generating payment files for the vendor.

**Lifecycle context:** Vendor bank file setup records are created before the first bank file payment batch is generated for the vendor. The bank account details are used when the payment batch is authorized and the bank file is submitted to the bank.

For more information, see [About bank files](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_file_payment) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Vendor contacts
tags.description:
A vendor contact associates a contact with a vendor, allowing multiple contacts to be linked to a single vendor under different category names such as main office or branch office.

**When to use:** Use to associate a contact with a vendor for organizing billing addresses, remittance information, or other location-specific contact details, or to retrieve the contacts linked to a vendor.

**Relationships:** Owned by a vendor. Each vendor contact links to a contact record in the company contact list.

**Lifecycle context:** Vendor contacts are set up after a vendor is created and before vendor-related transactions are processed. Contact details linked to a vendor are referenced in AP transactions and payment documents.

For more information, see [Vendor contact information](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Vendor_contact_information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Vendor email templates
tags.description:
A vendor email template links an email template to a vendor for a specific transaction type, automating standard messages sent to the vendor when that type of transaction document is issued.

**When to use:** Use to configure which email template is sent to a vendor for a specific transaction type, or to retrieve or update existing vendor email template configurations.

**Relationships:** Owned by a vendor. Each vendor email template references an email template from the company email template library and is associated with a specific transaction type.

**Lifecycle context:** Vendor email templates are configured before transaction documents are issued so that the automated messaging is in place when a qualifying transaction is created.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Vendor payment providers
tags.description:
A vendor payment provider links a payment provider service to a vendor, enabling electronic payment delivery through that provider. Payment provider services, such as Vendor Payments powered by CSI, are available for US vendors accepting USD.

**When to use:** Use to enroll a vendor in a payment provider service or to retrieve and update the subscription status and preferred payment method for an existing enrollment.

**Relationships:** Owned by a vendor. Each vendor payment provider references a payment provider from the cash management module and can have an optional preferred payment method.

**Lifecycle context:** Vendor payment providers are created to initiate enrollment with the payment provider service. The `state` field reflects the subscription status as reported by the provider, progressing from `requestInitiated` through to `subscribed` or `canceled`.

For more information, see [Compare payment methods](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=HDI_Select_Payment_Method) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Vendor restricted departments
tags.description:
A vendor restricted department limits a vendor to specific departments or department groups in a shared multi-entity company, preventing the vendor from being used outside those restrictions.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve the department or department group restrictions configured for a vendor in a shared multi-entity company.

**Relationships:** Owned by a vendor. Each vendor restricted department references either a department or a department group. Vendor restricted departments are created and maintained through the parent vendor.

**Lifecycle context:** Vendor restricted departments are configured as part of vendor setup in a shared multi-entity environment. Once configured, they restrict which departments the vendor can be used with across the company's entities.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Vendor restricted locations
tags.description:
A vendor restricted location limits a vendor to specific locations or location groups in a shared multi-entity company, preventing the vendor from being used outside those restrictions.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve the location or location group restrictions configured for a vendor in a shared multi-entity company.

**Relationships:** Owned by a vendor. Each vendor restricted location references either a location or a location group. Vendor restricted locations are created and maintained through the parent vendor.

**Lifecycle context:** Vendor restricted locations are configured as part of vendor setup in a shared multi-entity environment. Once configured, they restrict which locations the vendor can be used with across the company's entities.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Vendor types
tags.description:
Vendor types organize vendors into categories that are used for reporting. To share vendor
types across entities, create them at the top level. Creating vendor types in an entity
restricts them to that entity.

**When to use:** Use when categorizing vendors for reporting, assigning default 1099 form
settings to groups of vendors, or building a hierarchy of vendor types using parent-child
relationships.

**Relationships:** May have a parent vendor type to support hierarchical classification.
Referenced by vendor records that are assigned to the vendor type.

For more information, see [Vendor types](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_vendor_types) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Vendor groups
tags.description:
A vendor group categorizes vendors for use in financial reports, allowing vendor data to appear as rows or columns.

**When to use:** Use to create or manage vendor groups that organize vendors for dimensional reporting. Set up vendor groups before building financial reports that use vendors as a dimension.

**Relationships:** Contains vendor members specified individually in `groupMembers` or selected dynamically using `memberFilter` criteria. When `isDimensionStructure` is `true`, the group can be added to the rows or columns of a financial report layout.

**Lifecycle context:** Vendor groups are set up before financial reports that use them are created. Once configured as a dimension structure, the group determines the row and column headings for vendor data in reports.

For more information, see [Vendor groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Vendor_dimension_groups_po) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Accounts_Payable_Vendor totals
tags.description:
A vendor total provides a summary of the outstanding amount owed to a vendor, aggregated
across all AP transactions for that vendor.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving outstanding balances owed to a specific vendor or
across all vendors for reporting, reconciliation, or AP exposure monitoring.

**Relationships:** Associated with a vendor and optionally scoped to an entity. Reflects
the net balance from AP transactions such as bills, credit adjustments, and payments.

**Lifecycle context:** Represents the current AP balance position for a vendor. Updated
as AP transactions are created, paid, or adjusted throughout the AP lifecycle.

delete.description: Deletes an adjustment. Adjustments not applied to a bill can be deleted.

post.description:
You can submit a draft adjustment to post it. Draft adjustments are adjustments that have been created, but were not yet ready to post.

When you submit a draft adjustment, the state of the adjustment changes from `draft` to `posted`.

To cancel a posted adjustment, reverse it. To cancel a paid adjustment, void the payment and then reverse the adjustment. When you reverse an adjustment, the state changes from `posted` or `paid` to `reversed`.

Reversals are intended to serve as a documented record of the transaction history. For more information, see [Reverse an AP credit memo adjustment](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Reverse_AP_credit_memo_adjustment) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

delete.description: Deletes a bill. You can only delete unpaid bills that are in a `posted`, `draft`, or `declined` state. For partially paid bills, first cancel the payment request, which changes the bill's state to `posted`. post.description:
Submit a bill to move it to the next stage in the approval process. For example, submit a bill to move it from the `draft` state to the `submitted` state. When in the `submitted` state, the bill can then be approved or declined.

A bill that has a state of `declined` can be edited and then resubmitted, which changes its state to `submitted`. Once submitted, the bill can then be approved or declined.

Users with appropriate permissions can approve a bill. To be approved, a bill must have a state of `submitted` or `partiallyApproved`. Once approved, a `submitted` bill's state transitions to either `posted` or `partiallyApproved`, depending on whether all lines on the bill are released for payment. When a `partiallyApproved` bill is approved, its state transitions to `posted` if all remaining lines are released.

For more information, see [About bill approvals](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=AP_about_bill_approvals) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

Users with appropriate permissions can decline a bill after it's been submitted for approval. Bills with a state of `submitted` or `partiallyApproved` can be declined. Declining a bill changes the bill's state to `declined`.

Once a bill is declined, it cannot be recalled or approved unless it's resubmitted. For more information, see [Decline a bill](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Decline_bills) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

To edit a bill previously submitted for approval, recall the bill. A bill can be recalled only when it is in `submitted` state. Once recalled, the bill will be in `draft` state.





 For more information, see [Recall a submitted bill](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Recall_a_submitted_bill) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

Reverses a bill. Reversing a bill creates a record in the system for audit trail purposes. Bills with a state of `posted` or `paid` can be reversed, and the state of the bill will be updated to `reversed` after the reversal. The reversal date must be later than the original bill's posting date.

Bills with a state of `posted` are not yet paid and unpaid bills can only be reversed if Accounts Payable is enabled for reversal of unpaid bills.

For paid bills, the associated payment must first be voided. After the payment is voided, the bill can then be reversed.  

For more information, see [Reverse a bill](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=HDI_AP_Reverse_Bill) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

- `disputed` - There is a dispute regarding the invoice. This may ultimately lead to refusal or approval by the buyer.
- `notSent` - The invoice has not been sent to the platform.
- `inTransit` - The invoice has been sent and is in transit between platforms.
- `approved` - The invoice has been approved by the buyer.
- `receivedByPlatform` - The invoice has been received by the public invoicing portal or the buyer’s registered private platform but has not yet been made available to the buyer.
- `rejectedByPlatform` - The invoice can be automatically rejected by the platform on technical grounds (e.g. format, non-compliance with the standard, etc.). When the transmit platform rejects the invoice, the invoice must be corrected by its issuer and resubmitted to the platform.
- `suspended` - Processing of the invoice is temporarily suspended.

Controls and reports Form 1099 treatment for the line item.

In create and update requests:
- Set this property to `true` to include the line item in 1099 reporting. The effective form type and box are determined from `form1099` and the applicable vendor or account label configuration.
- Set this property to `false` to exclude the line item from 1099 reporting and clear its associated form type and box.
- Set this property to `null` to let the system determine 1099 treatment from the applicable configuration.
- If omitted from an update request, the existing value remains unchanged.

dimension-status.description:
Status of the dimension object:

* `active` - Transactions can be posted to this dimension member and it can be used in reports.
* `activeNonPosting` - Transactions cannot be posted to the dimension member but it can be used in reports.
* `inactive` - The dimension member cannot be used for transactions or reports.

filterExpression.description:
Logical operators to apply when there are multiple filter conditions. The conditions in the `filters` array are implicitly numbered starting at 1. Supports `and`, `or`, and grouping with parentheses.

Shortcuts:
+ `and` by itself means that all conditions must be true.
+ `or` by itself means that at least one condition must be true.

orderBy.description: Sort order for the results that match the `filters` when the group is displayed in reports. The entry consists of a field name to sort by and whether it should be sorted in ascending or descending order.

size.description: The maximum number of records that match the `filters` to include in the group when it is displayed in reports.
